name: Green Software Practitioner
description: Learn the concepts needed to build, maintain and run greener applications
accessibilitySummary: 20 minutes of video content across 4 modules

audience.audienceType: Anyone involved in the process of building, deploying, or managing software, anyone who wants to make their software applications more sustainable and build a career in green software

competencyRequired: No prior knowledge of computing infrastructure required, ideally have at least one year of industry experience building, deploying, or managing software applications.
teaches: Explaining why traditional carbon metrics fail to drive action in software teams
Describing the two boundaries that every metric must align to drive the right actions
Calculating operational and embodied emissions using the SCI equation
Explaining why the SCI excludes market-based measures like offsets and RECs
Selecting appropriate quantification methods based on available data
Applying the SCI equation to real software systems

about.name: SCI Fundamentals (Basics of Software Carbon Intensity)
